name: raw_decile_turnover_exploration_20260917
execution: AutoDL only; local workstation authors code and renders reports
signal: Original factor column from frozen model inference, without clipping, standardization or industry/style neutralization
portfolio: Daily equal-weight long highest 10% (Q10) and short lowest 10% (Q1); targets +100% and -100% of post-fee NAV. Ten groups are defined in raw score ascending order with instrument order for ties, before prices or future labels.
buffer: Keep existing long/short names while inside the configured extreme band; fill each side to 10% using current raw-score rank. These are Q10/Q1-based buffered strategies, not exact daily extreme deciles.
execution_time: Signal after close, trade at next open; hold continuously including overnight; last available open reserved for liquidation
marking: Daily adjusted close; missing close uses current known opening mark, missing open blocks trading and uses previous known close/mark
annualization: 252 times arithmetic mean of daily close-to-close portfolio returns across all 402 sessions, including initial cash day
sharpe: sqrt(252) times daily mean divided by sample standard deviation (ddof=1); risk-free rate zero; net Sharpe at stated fees
turnover: Daily (buy notional + sell notional)/(2 * pre-trade opening NAV), including initial/terminal trading; mean over all 402 sessions
scope: Exploratory retrospective comparison after seeing 2025-2026 results. All rules and phases fixed before this batch. No untouched test set; do not call the winner validated or guaranteed.
selection: Show every rule and phase. Compare turnover, net annual return, Sharpe, drawdown, and 2025/2026 separately. Report phase ranges for reduced-frequency rules. Do not suppress failed candidates.
partial: Blend normalized existing signed weights with current target at alpha; net overlapping opposite positions, then normalize each signed leg to +1/-1. First trade is full; retained positions without a current score get zero target. This can hold more than 100 names per side.
frequency: First available open builds the portfolio in every phase. Thereafter trade when (t-1-phase)%k==0; unchanged share quantities between trade dates, so leverage drifts. All phases reported. Last open liquidates all tradable positions.
